extract: Mariannette Jane Miller-Meeks is an American physician and politician who has served as a U.S. representative from Iowa since 2021. Her district, numbered the 2nd from 2021 to 2023 and the 1st since 2023, includes most of Iowa's southeastern quadrant, including Davenport, Bettendorf, Burlington, and Iowa City.
